patterns.note: Alternating full-bleed image sections with content blocks, often using a split layout (image on one side, text/CTA on the other) or a grid for product displays.
A high-contrast palette featuring a vibrant, almost neon yellow as a primary accent color, paired with deep blue for calls-to-action, and a clean black and white base.
Headings use a distinctive, bold, and slightly condensed sans-serif font, creating a strong brand voice, while body text uses a more conventional, highly readable sans-serif.

The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background image scrolls slower than the foreground content. Sections below the hero appear to reveal or fade in as they enter the viewport.

The primary navigation bar transitions from a transparent state with white text and logo to a solid white background with black text and logo, sticking to the top of the viewport after initial scroll.

technique_notes: The hero section achieves a sense of depth by having its background image scroll at a slower rate than the overlaying text and call-to-action, creating a parallax effect. This can be implemented using CSS transforms or JavaScript scroll event listeners.

The sticky navigation bar dynamically changes its styling (background color, text color, and potentially height) once the user scrolls past the initial hero section, providing a clear visual cue of its active state. This can be done with JavaScript observing scroll position and adding/removing classes.

Content sections are revealed with a subtle animation, likely a fade-in or slide-up effect, as they enter the user's viewport. This common scroll-triggered animation pattern is often handled by libraries like `locomotive-scroll` or Intersection Observer API combined with CSS transitions/keyframes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (hero text ~4-5x body) create a strong visual hierarchy, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and product cards, with more pronounced rounding on testimonial cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a well-defined grid for product displays and feature blocks.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its energetic and playful brand identity, achieved through the bold use of a vibrant, almost neon yellow accent color and a unique, chunky display typeface. This is effectively balanced with high-quality, aspirational lifestyle photography, making the product feel both premium and approachable.
